notes: Five proposals, four registered modules plus the endoflife dataset family and two correlation rules. circl_vulnlookup (P181): record via the ONE shared CVE JSON 5 parser of cve_record (cve5_attributes include_kev=False), OSV records for GHSA/PySec ids, CSAF for vendor ids; keywords are sent only when they are advisory ids; 404 and the live 200 {} are EMPTY; sightings from the oldest-first timeline (8 MiB cap, never cached: third-party handles/post texts stay in memory, evidence keeps counts/dates/families) with a fallback to the newest-first sighting list (first date only when complete); seen/exploited/confirmed -> exploited['circl'] (setting circl_vulnlookup_exploited_types), never kev; EPSS from CIRCL only when the local EPSS file cannot answer; optional key circl_vuln as X-API-KEY; per-endpoint sources via extension circl_vulnlookup__p2-G08-1.json so coverage shows a sightings/EPSS failure while the record answered. osv_ghsa (P185): OSV CVE/GHSA + DEBIAN-/UBUNTU-CVE distro records, GitHub REST through the P111 shared client (github_user.GitHubClient, keyless for analyst-typed CVEs only), OSV GHSA mirror when GitHub is not cleared or fails; per-source filtering via ctx.allowed_sources; no package queries; compact ranges in evidence. vulncheck (P186): per-CVE module (the offline backup variant waits for the team key and a core two-step download - backlog); hits -> exploited['vulncheck_kev'] + exploitation_refs/exploit_refs, never kev; 401/402/403 NEEDS_KEY; error envelope in 200 -> ERROR via module marker. securitycontext_cve (P188): GET /v1/cves/{id} only, CVE input only (keywords are not IOC_TYPES), schema check, comparison-only attribute cve_secondary + rule g08_cve_secondary_conflicts; terms/tier unknown -> off everywhere. endoflife (P187): no Module class by design (cond 1); 68 datasets endoflife.<slug> registered from v3lum/data/endoflife/eol_products.json (74 names + 76 CPE vendor:product keys, pinned) and rule g08_endoflife (explicit versions -> medium/low on own/in-scope assets, info on third-party, version-inferred CPE/fingerprints info <= 0.4, distro builds never upstream EOL, one grouped correlation per asset).
